hops.summary: Accept; no blocking Findings. Verified the full C1 deliverable independently, including the maintainer-owned baseline inputs. The committed .wfc/config.yaml parses with the real consumer_config_from_yaml (no invented key survives _mapping's closed vocabulary; governance_dir passes the A1 path shape; adapter and raw are inside _ADAPTERS/EVIDENCE_RAW_CHOICES); every value matches the plan's config-recommendation verbatim, the ceiling equals the existing repository-standard@v1 literal and hop ceiling 10 (commissioning.py:327-331), and default_execution matches the bindings actually used for self-development today (tests/fixtures/bp5/real_run/ops/execution-bindings.yaml), satisfying open-decisions item 3. resolve_evidence(config, Path('/payload/workflow-coordinator'), {}) returns repository_root.parent/'workflow-coordinator-run-evidence' with raw 'commit' against a nonexistent path and an empty environment, so the pure-function criterion holds. Beyond the small parser, a read-only probe compiled a robust@v1 Commission through the real compile_commission with the committed config and the committed guidance read from HEAD, and resolve_execution resolved both roles with no flags. The guidance is 45 lines, subordinates itself to its sources, and every rule was traced to existing material (ch03_engineering_conventions 11-39; backlog/README 26-30; ch02 01_authority 116-120 and 02_authoring 64; ch06 02_successors 190; ch04 01_acceptance 167-175; ch02 03_review; doc_conventions; CLAUDE.md 12-14) - no new standard. The Worker test is mutation-sensitive, not tautological: 16 single-value config mutations plus missing/whitespace-only guidance each fail exactly the matching assertion while the unmutated baseline passes (probe redirected the module paths at a scratch copy; .wfc/ was never edited). The manual note is an 8-line pure insertion recording all three required facts accurately, with no other manual text rewritten. a6ffa90 changed only the two authorized leaves; .wfc/, src/, scripts/, governance/self-development and existing tests are unchanged, no second archive path and no Run state movement. Four non-blocking observations are recorded in the artifact only (guidance citation precision for three rules, incl. the unqualified whole-product review rule vs ch02 03_review's bounded-rereview guidance; committing both default roles makes a worker-only program unresolvable; the absolute-path scan cannot see YAML list items, harmless because _path already refuses absolute ceiling entries; 'changes no behavior on its own' is precise only for the Harness path since plan.py:35/lifecycle.py:71 default --config to .wfc/config.yaml). Agent-side runs are exploratory, not Coordinator-trusted evidence. The only proposed repository change is the review artifact; no agent Git write was performed.
